evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content was present; A absent.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red/blue coordinates) and an explicit origin/organization entry are present for the same referent/time, and content identity is distinguished from origin/status.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to content presentation/access was stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content items (color-labeled coordinate sets) are identified with attributes.

D.rationale: The report separately records content identity (coordinate sets) and a distinct origin/status entry for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Entries label items as current vs candidate and include explicit origin/representation metadata, describing how contents are organized/accessed.
